purpose.zh: 拉开屁股，久坐胯发紧时松一松
purpose.en: Stretches your butt to ease tight hips from sitting.

text.zh: 一只脚踝搭在另一边膝盖上，背挺直往前倾
text.en: Cross one ankle over the other knee and lean forward with a long back

text.zh: 另一只脚踩平，翘起的膝盖自然往外打开。
text.en: Other foot flat, let the crossed knee fall open.

text.zh: 搭着的那条小腿放平，膝盖自然往下落。
text.en: Keep the crossed shin level and let that knee drop.

text.zh: 呼气时胸口往小腿那边再靠近一点，背别弓。
text.en: Each breath out, bring your chest a little closer to your shin, back long.

commonErrors.en: Rounding your back to go deeper.
Forcing your knee down with your hand.
Pushing the knee down with your hand.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼就少往前倾点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knee hurts, don't lean as far. Stop if it still hurts.
